skill.summary: Polish drafts with structured grammar, style, clarity, and readability feedback.

content.value_statement: Drafts often contain grammar issues, unclear phrasing, and inconsistent style. This skill gives structured editing feedback that improves readability while preserving voice.
actual_capabilities: Identifies grammar, punctuation, spelling, and agreement issues in prose.
Flags passive voice, weak verbs, repetition, and wordiness.
Reviews tone, point of view, tense, and spelling consistency.
Estimates readability using sentence length and grade-level guidance.
Suggests revised passages while explaining the reason for each change.
Adapts feedback for fiction, nonfiction, academic, and audience needs.
limitations: It relies on the text and context supplied by the user.
It cannot guarantee compliance with every publication style guide.
It may suggest edits that do not match the author voice.
It does not verify factual claims or citations independently.

use_cases.title: Polish Fiction Scenes
use_cases.description: Review scenes for weak verbs, repetition, pacing, sentence variety, and voice preservation.

use_cases.title: Improve Academic Drafts
use_cases.description: Strengthen formal tone, clarity, citation awareness, and sentence structure in academic passages.

use_cases.title: Edit Business Writing
use_cases.description: Make emails, reports, and proposals clearer, more concise, and more consistent.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Grammar Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review for a short passage.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this passage for grammar, punctuation, and spelling. List the most important fixes first and explain each one briefly.

prompt_templates.title: Clarity and Concision Pass
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this draft for wordiness, unclear phrasing, weak verbs, and repetition. Suggest concise revisions that preserve my tone.

prompt_templates.title: Genre Style Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review with audience and genre context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this text for grammar, readability, pacing, and genre fit. The genre is [genre] and the target audience is [audience].

prompt_templates.title: Full Editorial Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a structured grammar and style report for this draft. Include strengths, priority issues, examples, revised passages, and next steps.

output_examples.input: The hallway was very dark. Sarah was walking quickly because she was scared.
output_examples.output: The report flags weak verbs, repeated was constructions, and tell-not-show phrasing. It suggests stronger verbs and a more sensory revision.

output_examples.input: Many researchers think that climate change is a really big problem.
output_examples.output: The report recommends a more formal tone, more precise wording, and citation support for academic claims.

output_examples.input: Please review this client email for clarity and tone.
output_examples.output: The review highlights unclear requests, redundant phrases, tone mismatches, and a cleaner version suitable for professional communication.

best_practices: Provide the genre, audience, and target tone before asking for edits.
Review suggestions in passes, such as grammar first and style second.
Accept only the changes that preserve meaning and author voice.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a full manuscript review without clear priorities.
Do not apply every style suggestion automatically.
Do not use style edits as a substitute for factual verification.

faq.question: Can this skill rewrite my text?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest revised passages, but it should preserve meaning and voice unless you request a stronger rewrite.

faq.question: Does it work for fiction and nonfiction?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for fiction, academic writing, and general prose when enough context is provided.

faq.question: Will it follow a specific style guide?
faq.answer: It can align with a style guide you name, but it does not replace an official style manual.

faq.question: Can it check citations?
faq.answer: It can flag missing or vague citation needs, but it does not independently verify sources.

faq.question: How much text should I submit?
faq.answer: Short sections work best. Use chapter-sized or smaller chunks for detailed feedback.

faq.question: Can it preserve my voice?
faq.answer: Yes. State how much voice preservation matters, then review suggested edits before applying them.
